text: I'm sure the owners/staff are great people just trying to succeed. Their inexperience and lack of focus is their undoing. They did not have half of the appetizers available. The hummus was good (not great) but only a small amount of pita for five people. The orders were mixed up or forgotten. Food was ok, Not good or great.  The final price was way too high for what they deliver.  For a two minute drive down the street Caravan is a much better value with superior service.  In fact there are several middle eastern/Mediterranean in town with better food and most importantly service.

Hands down the best fried chicken I've ever had! 

I ordered the 3 piece fried chicken with a side of Mac and cheese and peas. Chicken - The skin was delicate and crunchy. The inside was absolutely juicy and flavorful. For dessert, I tried the banana bread pudding which was warm and served with strawberries. Definitely a go to when you visit New Orleans!

Ok so based on food alone, this place is 5 stars. The food is awesome-Asian fusion done right. I took off a single star for ambiance, service, environment/comfort. It's found in a little strip mall area by a Subway and Burger King, and inside is set up very casual, which is fine. The outside patio area is cute but we were literally drenched by the end of the meal because the misting system to keep it cool out there is quite intense (see fog in photo). Our table was completely wet as well.

Ok so on to the good part-food! We started with the crispy fried green beans (pan fried-not battered and deep fried)-delish and felt somewhat healthy; we also got the coconut milk queso (different, shrimpy but good) and the wings with nuoc man caramel (holy moly-best wings of your life, I could drink the "caramel" sauce-not like your typical caramel, but an amazing burst of savory and only touch of sweet umami). We the. Got the pork belly bowl to share as our entree, which was awesome and huge, had a lot of meat in it (both pork belly as well as pulled pork). For drinks, my husband tried the Mopho punch (refreshing) and the tamarind sour (good, quite sour).

Overall, we will definitely be back. It's a great casual date night spot with awesome food. Will probably ask to not be seated outside again unless the misters are not going.

Great food! Shaq is a great waiter; very attentive and friendly! Red is great too, he tells jokes and is very friendly as well. I like this place better than Joe's Crab Shack. We'll definitely come back again.

It's open! The topping station was spotless and so was the rest of the store. I love their dole whip. The girls got their concoction of sugar monstrosities that don't seem to go together i.e. captain crunch ice cream with mango boba toppings?!
Whatever your creativity, they have it and they are ready. They also have a covered patio dining area open.

Besides my family and friends your tomato pie is the thing I miss the most since moving to Florida. If you could just figure out a way to ship life would be better. My son brought some home last time he was there and we shared it with neighbors and got them all hooked also!!

This is a beautiful location. The food is expensive as expected. The cake was delicious but they were missing three of the cakes due to low inventory. I will warn people not to sit on the patio if you don't want to be bothered by the Gnats.  My friend and I both ordered quiche which came with a small salad. The bugs were all over us on the patio. It was hot out there because the windows were open and the bugs are everywhere while you're eating. My experience would've been better if I was sitting indoors but I did not know to ask to be seated inside. They did not ask us where we would like to sit.  Service was good.  I would recommend that the windows be closed and air conditioner on this time of year.  If the windows are open, request to eat indoors.

Been on my list of a minute and it definitely lived up to all expectations! I had an assortment of Taco Tuesday tacos and fresh strawberry lemonade. The cauliflower and oysters were the standout stars and the teriyaki sauce was one by far the best I've had. The service was impeccable and I can't wait to come back to this NOLA gem!

Great local spot for Italian. We found ourselves frequenting on Fridays during the lockdown. There are a wide variety of options so we were able to visit frequently but still have a variety of items. There are both pizzas and pasta. Staff is warm and welcoming. Your money really goes a long way and you can get a lot for your money. Definitely a spot you can enjoy for lunch or dinner. Highly recommend visiting.

This is my first time at this First watch location. We were the only ones in the restaurant. Our server was very nice and attentive. The restaurant was super clean. I ordered the traditional breakfast. The eggs were a bit over cooked and the bacon was a bit dry otherwise this would be a 5 star review. I'd would have no issues coming here for breakfast again.

Lovely family run Greek restaurant in Catalina.  This is our third visit, once for lunch and twice for dinner. Today was a special Greek Orthodox Easter buffet for $25, which included spit roasted lamb. Everything was fresh and delicious. Google the red egg tradition!

Get on their email list for specials like this & make reservations!
This is an awesome new steakhouse in town, I highly recommend! The food is amazing, service is even better! Joe and Jose were awesome, go see them and get an incredible steak dinner!

Hands down the worst place in IV. I don't usually leave yelp reviews but this place left a really bad taste in my mouth. I ate here twice after they first opened and wasn't really impressed but decided to give them another shot tonight because their 1000+ yelp reviews which are actually from their other location in OC (they just changed their address to cover up previous poor reviews for this one) were decent. I ordered the Nashville Hawt Chicken Burger and it was just so awful. The soggy chicken looked and tasted exactly like the Tyson chicken strips from Costco and the hot sauce they use is a chili garlic paste that doesn't come anywhere near to the flavor you'd expect from Nashville hot chicken. Also, If you have questions you shouldn't expect any sort of customer service because apparently the person working the register "doesn't work there" lmao. I recommend taking your money elsewhere.

This is my favorite Mexican cuisine 
restaurant in all of St. Louis! 

I'm a very picky eater, 
so that's really saying something.

The chicken chimichangas are my #1!

The servers are super attentive & polite. 
(Tips are well deserved.)

Parking is a game of patience that's often rewarded. 

Waiting for a table is its own adventure...
Spend some time looking at the walls, 
check out the hand painted murals.

Don't forget to try the margaritas.

This place has been open for 2yrs, but this is the first time I'm checking it out. The inside is pretty small, has two 4tops and one 6top [during the pandemic]. There is a good sized patio whenever the weather gets warmer with picnic tables. 

We got two pizzas and dough buds. The dough buds are amazing, they are not dry- dressed well with garlic and butter. The Pineapple Express has a sweet pulled pork barbecue sauce and was delicious. The Trap Pizza is their seafood pizza, it's different and in a good way. I may want to try it with a different sauce next time if they allow a swap for a white sauce. 

They have a few canned sodas and some beer and wine options. Not a huge offering but my friend was able to get a local beer for $2. 

Last of all, the service is amazing! There were steady pick-ups while we dined in, and she still checked in with us a couple times.
Great menu. Good food.  Good drinks.  Great service. Pretty cool ambiance. Nice place to hang with friends.

Came here for drinks, chips and guacamole before heading to dinner. Guacamole was $15 and although good, it only came with three tostados. When I asked for extra they brought 3 more and charged an additional $3. They have some guts charging that much and for that alone I will never come back. $50 for two drinks and 4 ounces of guacamole you can have it.
The young lady that's always there, knows our order and is VERY nice. The Pho is always on point. LOVE this place !

I went tonight to celebrate my son's 13th B-Day and I was impressed after a while not going there I can tell this was the best outback I've ever been to, the food was Amazing  and the server was beyond excellent. I will recommend this to anyone that is looking for a good steakhouse!!!

In a word: delicious. Their buffalo bleu chickn sandwich is seriously one of my favorite sandwiches of all time. The employees were friendly and helpful and our food came out fast!! The only drawback to this location, as other reviewers have mentioned, is the lack of seating and lack of restroom. The seating area is quite small and in close proximity to the entryway so on chilly days it can be a bit cold when you're eating inside. I also think a restaurant, even a small one, should have a restroom for patrons.

This location is horrible. Front of house staff are really rude. They're service is super slow even when the restaurant isn't as busy as their rush times. They need cooks that understand that a message rare steak isn't well done. I wish I could give this place negative stars. This place sucks

Pull up a chair and relax while I tell you how amazing this food is. 

First off. Wow. Everything I tried was fresh and flavorful. There wasn't one dish that was just okay. It all left me wanting more - but there's no way I could have eaten more because the portion sizes are perfect. 

I came in with my family for lunch and we were seated immediately. All of us ordered off of the lunch special menu which was an appetizer, an entree, and a desert for around $14. 

I ordered the hummus, gyro, and baklava. I loved it. My mom got an appetizer that was just amazing but I forget what it was - something "salsa."  I could have eaten a salad whole plate of it. 
And the baklava was, no exaggeration, the best I've ever had. It was fresh and warm and the dollop of cream on the side was perfectly refreshing. 

As if the food wasn't good enough - the service here is amazing. Our waiter was so kind and the owner stopped by our table many times to check on us and chat. We had our newborn son with us and both the server and the owner doted over him which was sweet. 

I can't wait to come back here. With everyone I know. And try everything they have. I'm so glad to have this lovely cafe in our city!

The sandwiches here at Lee's Deli are the best you'll ever have in your life!  Each sandwich is made with care and attention, and the customer service is perfect!  They have a wide variety of things you can order as well as their secret menu on Instagram at lees_deli where the food is a product of the chefs creative power and culinary knowledge.  The layout is homey and atmosphere is relaxing.  Not to mention they have The Carrot Cake Man's carrot cakes!  Five time best in Philly you can't pass that up!  I've seen tourists from all over come to eat here just because it was the best rated place and every time they leave I only see good things from them!  This restaurant surpasses all other so don't pass up your opportunity to stay here and eat!

Oh, so good!!  I stopped in on a whim and grabbed slices; plain cheese slice, and a garlic, broccoli white slice, and they were Divine!  Nice clean pizza, not dripping with grease.  Restaurant was clean and homey with cute sayings around to read. While you eat.  Windows were open a little to let the crisp fall breeze in, families with happy** children.....just an all-around lovely experience.  Highly recommend!!
(**individual results may vary)

This place is fantastic!  What could be better than hot, made-to-order, donuts?  I highly recommend the French Toast donut and my own creation: lemon glaze with shredded coconut on top.  Yum!  Newtown is lucky to have Factory Donuts!
This is the place to go for fried chicken strips, juicy, tender, crisp but not dried out.  Also try the pork rinds, delicious!

Ordered through GrubHub and it took longer than expected to come. When I called them the lady that answered the phone was very apologetic.

The food arrived and it was really good. Probably the best lo mein I've ever had. I'll definitely order from them again.

So I've been going to this place since it opened and believe it can bounce between a 3 and 4 stars.. 
pros- steady tasting food.. decent service from numerous servers at the high tops and tables. I've never had a bad meal yet, as long as you let the staff know your cooking preference. A
Good local place to grab a quick bite and beer..

Cons- based on my experience, if your a patron that sit on the very end of the bar, you seem to be invisible to the bar staff.. I don't know whether it's the set up or bar staff that focus on both sides of the bar.. 
I know it's the days of iPhones and the like, but I am not happy with the bar staff constantly checking their phone or also checking how they look using the phone.. do patrons a favor, focus on where your tips will come from.  Despite this, I will continue to stop in and enjoy a beer.

Foods been going down hill. I usually go for the chicken tacos but lately my food has been coming out cold. French fries are decent. 

If you go, get the pretzel bites.

Great beer selection and cool atmosphere makeup for the not so warm tacos.
Don't get the pulled pork, it's awful.  Just got it for takeout and it was dripping with grease, the buns were actually soaked by the time i was able to take my first bite. GROSS!!!!
Such a delicious acai bowl and a nice atmosphere! There's so much on the menu that sounds amazing and I'd gladly go back again.
Must make a stop here every SB visit! Highly recommend coffee roasting place. Variety, aroma, freshness

Awesome location, atmosphere, vibe, staff, food, and drinks!! R&b playing when I walked in.. vibrant interior & smiling staff! The food didn't take long and it was super fresh! Also very authentic and generous portions. I had a bowl with trini rice & peas, honey jerk chicken, caramelized onions, tomatoes, and queso fresco cheese! Delicious and enough for 2 to eat. I also ordered a small jerk chicken plate with macaroni & cucumber mango salad! All very delicious. The meat was juicy and flavorful. Sides where fresh.. it's like you could taste every ingredient! Yummy! The pineapple coconut juice was bussing!! 10 stars

I have been coming to Ruby Slipper restaurants since they were on Cortez. So glad a breakfast place opened up on Metairie Road. The staff is very friendly. I usually get the same thing (Migas) every time.  I got something new today and it was just as good. The food is always good. The coffee is the best. Family friendly.

Fabulous brunch experience! I tried the huevos rancheros, tortilla topped with special sauce,  black beans,  cheese,  fried eggs and salsa.  Delicious.  Blood orange mimosa and grand mimosa were tasty.  My husband had chicken and waffles and enjoyed every bite.  My daughter couldn't decide so ordered the kids pancakes and kids French toast; she will be enjoying this breakfast for a couple more days.  Huge portions!  French toast for my son, yet another pleaser. 

Service was excellent,  good distancing from other diners, attention to detail,  timely service.  Hand sanitizer was everywhere. All staff wore masks. Glad we ventured out.

angry! very angry!! very very angry!!! 
this place (I cannot call it a RESTAURANT) did NOT RESPECT customer.  We stepped in and nobody stayed in the front to arrange the seat.  We wait for about 15 mins still no one come to meet us. We only see a lot of waiters and waitress chatting with each other. No one care about us. The staffs are very rude, impolite,  impatient! horrible experience!!! I would give NEGATIVE STARS,  but Yelp does not allow me to comment unless I give one star.
Genuinely amazing. Staff is also super friendly! Got the hot Chik's sammich and the mac. Dayummmm

Don't believe the hype or what the hipsters are telling you. This place is just alright. First things first, this is suppose to be Seminole Heights first sports bar? Ok - in what way? Yes, they have a bunch of tvs playing sports including a projector playing some sports game on one of the walls. That wall is only really view-able by a couple of the low-top tables. But none of the volume for any of the sports games were on. Instead you are a prisoner to listening to satellite radio of some music station which was playing indie rock music. Heard 2 Black Keys songs for the short time eating there. Really annoying to hear this music at a "sports" bar. The place is also very small inside; not just for the eating section but the bar section too. You feel very cramped. And you won't get service until about 10-15 minutes after you seat yourself. Saw a few different people getting up from their table to get their own menu. Thought that was weird and not friendly

Now to the food. Not bad but not really good either. Me and my wife started off with their chicken wings. We got them breaded and with Buffalo wing sauce style. Took a very long time for them to come out and when they did, they seemed barely breaded. Didn't really have a good crunch or taste to the breading. The sauce tasted like it came from a can/bottle. The meat was tender and the wings themselves were meaty. But definitely had better wings at other places
We then wound up getting Social House's burgers. I got the Cali Bur

I've never had king cake before being from New England. My birthday is close to Mardi Gras so my boyfriend ordered me two king cakes. One with cream cheese and another with strawberry cream cheese. When we got the cakes, we cut into the box labeled strawberry cream cheese and it was not that. I have no idea what kind it was but I was not a fan at all. We called the bakery to ask them to either refund the cake or send us the correct one and the guy on the phone was incredibly rude. They ended up never sending a cake or refunding the cake. I'm so disappointed. I will not buy another cake from them.

Perhaps this restaurant has not noticed there is a Pandemic in the country that has killed in excess of 300,000. Went to dinner at 8:30 PM to avoid crowds and They were at 100% capacity with Lhasa no socially distance procedures in place. Really!!!   I promptly turned around and walked out. 

What does this tell their valued customers???  That their profits are more important that your health and that of others. That is the last time I will visit this restaurant. How irresponsible can this business owner be? Of course they are likely safely at home collecting profits while the employee risk their health. Perhaps they will come down with the virus and their perspective will change and they will begin to value other's lives. 

The only reason I gave it one star is that there is no option for not providing any.

Ruby Tuesday is one of my favorites, especially this one near me. Food is always good and not the same old thing as everywhere else. 
Went today with my family after church. I had the bourbon glazed salmon with real mashed potatoes and green beans and the rest (six of us) got other items. All was good, but here's the really good part. My wife told the manager about the apples on the salad bar being soft. Not a complaint, just an observation. He not only brought fresh Waldorf salad, he brought a large dessert for the table. Great food, great service, great job!
A true Chicago pizza in the middle of Oldsmar Florida. The thin crust and deep dish options are both top notch. Highly recommended!

First thanks to the awesome Yelpers who recommended this place!!  I didn't know my previous favorite brunch spot was closed so I was a bit bummed!  But I hopped on Yelp and this place looked very interested. The restaurant as a whole is very nice the environment is really cool. They have a loft type upstairs that is very nice. I ordered the chicken biscuit and a side of hash browns. The chicken biscuit was good but it's not a chick filet chicken biscuit but still good.  The hash browns were awesome!!  I will definitely come back I hear the stuffed French toast is great. So overall it was a great experience and I'm looking forward to coming back.

The atmosphere is really nice. They have really nice outside seating as well. The service was not great but wasn't horrible. Fish N' Chips was one of the best we have ever had but the Caesar salad was just ok and for some reason the cheese grits were very cold and weren't much better than instant grits. All in all we would give it another chance because we do think there is potential here.

the waitreses were absolutly disrespectful on another level they had zero patience and kicked us out even after we made a reservation they said exactly,"you need to leave there are people waiting for the table", we asked for a to go box tey said,"i dont care get out" we asked to speak to the manager and we were threatened if we didnt leave they were going to call the police. I would not recommend this place unless you want to be disrespected like its your fault that people cant be seated and keep in mine we were only seated and hour and 30 minutes and its took 30 minutes for the food to come.
Always very kind staff and my order is ready on time if not a little bit earlier.   Thank you

The absolute BEST kabob/Halal/falafel kinda food anywhere in this area. The best LEGIT white sauce out of any other kabob place in Delaware. The BEST hot sauce. The freshest green salad, just lettuce/tomato/onion, and with the white sauce, it's AMAZING. I'm always torn between getting the chicken platter and the falafel platter, they are SO good. You can't go wrong with anything on the menu though. The fish is awesome too, perfectly fried. Always ask for extra, extra sauce, both white and hot. The rice sucks it right up and you'll want more. Promise. Check them out!! Look up their menu online and call ahead, but it's also definitely worth the 10-20 min wait if you order when you get there.

Thank you, next.

Ordered delivery from Zaxby's because we wanted something different. we're about 7 minutes from the restaurant. Hubby and I got boneless wings, chicken fingers, sides, and a chicken salad.
This is not anything special. Probably the best part was the french fries. 
To start, we're unpacking the bag and they only sent ranch dressing. we ordered several of the sauces because we wanted to try them and we got zero.
Second, the chicken is not flavorful. It's just breading with no spices. Maybe it would have been better had we had something to dip it in. The toast was burnt, hard, and dry. The salad though was ginormous. It was good but it wasn't enough to save this meal. 
Maybe we'll try Zaxby's again in the restaurant after we forget this experience. Until then, pass.
Good food and my favorite as always the bubba tea. Nice people. Very highly recommended to those who wants to try filipino food. Try this place and you won't regret it.

This was my first visit to the gyro shack, I was the only customer (drive thru) and didn't have to wait long.  we ordered a gyro, a salad and two children's meals.  We ordered our girls the grilled chicken strips, with fries and milk. Upon opening our order , I was tearing smaller pieces for my girls to eat and noticed the chicken although it looked great was extremely hard, extremely dense and even difficult to tear. I took a bite and it was hard and rubbery-an awful, unnatural texture. I was so disappointed all of the strips were like this! Completely inedible!  The salad I ordered and paid for was not in our bag, and unfortunately the soft drinks we ordered were very light in syrup. Not a very good meal and eating experience for our family.
The gyro (made of gyro meat ) did taste good and the gentleman working the drive thru was nice. In all honesty we will not be returning to be disappointed again. 
-From two little hungry girls and a frustrated mom

Visiting from out of town and our first time at mambos. The food was sooooo freaking good! Brittany was our waitress and she was so sweet and knowledgeable of literally everything on the menu. We had the shrimp and gator nachos, mambos blackened red fish, cheese burger, and a fish platter. Brianna was our bartender and the drinks were delicious! I personally had the sangria and yumm!!

So good I went two nights in a row. I ordered online through a decent user interface for ordering. Food was ready when I got there. First night I got Thai wings and Mee Siam. Wings were crispy and great flavor. Noodle dish had great flavor with a mix of tofu and shrimp. Second night I went with roti and the dry roast pork noodles. The roti oddly was the highlight. Flaky and buttery. So good. That's no knock on the noodles, but something about the roti made my meal.

THE BEST WET BURRITO 
We stumbled across Ables by accident, after being stranded this side of the boarder due to I-80 getting closed.  And all I can say is THANK GOD  we did! 

This was not only THE BEST Mexican food We've had, but some of the best customer experience I've ever seen and left us feeling like best friends with the owners. This family run establishment is everything you hope for when going out to eat: phenomenal food, great service, good vibe, and just an overall atmosphere that left you feeling like you need to come back, and should have tipped more! 

I cannot recommend you visit here more! This place needs to survive these tough times! Trust me it is worth the visit and will be some of the best money you've spent.

This place is awesome, classy tone wood finishes around the place so it feels upscale. I've been here for my graduation at the one in philly and then again for a business meeting, it's nice and you'll enjoy the environment. They have super high ceilings and a bar so it feels grand. They have room to accommodate pretty much any size party and it's located in the heart of KoP near the mall, lots of corporate people tend to frequent

The buffet here is awesome as the spreads range from soup to salads to cheeses the charcuterie meats, can't beat it

Now comes the meats, you get an endless amount of different types, meats wrapped with sausages, different cut of steaks with your choice of rare to however cooked you would like. They give you a coin looking paper thing that shows green for more and red for no more meats. The picanha I personally think is the best cut cause it's got the fatty parts. Since it's eat till your heart desires, you come outta here feeling good, like what you'd imagine heaven would be for carnivores lol

Classic Peter Piper Pizza! Ordered take out which took less than 15 minutes! Food  was well prepared, made fresh, and just as tasty as I remember it as a kid!

Definitely recommend this location!

We started with the breakfast pies....the crust was flakey and buttery and had a sweet jam drizzle with a slight kick. I had the garden naan sandwich which was loaded with fresh veggies and was full of flavor. They had a purple cabbage slaw that I chose as my side and I was very happy with it. The coffee there is fresh from Kahwa. 
We went 1pm on a Sunday and we didn't have to wait to be seated. The atmosphere is very rustic/vintage and wasn't too loud at all. 
Overall great experience and the food was all delicious!
It's an amazing place , food and people are very friendly ... I love outside decorations, it made us feel comfortable even it was cold.!
Was not the best lunch this time around. They normally have great food. Will try again soon.
Mediocre food.  Poor service.  If you're just turning 21, they have beer.  I would love a good brew pub.  This isn't one.  Also they close at the same time your local Protestant church closes.

Quality has gone downhill and the prices haven't gotten any lower. Service is usually good, but unfortunately the food, presentation and taste, is really lacking. Very few vegetarian and vegan options.

My wife and I went here if you weeks ago I did a friend of mine and myself if you weeks before that and both times were exceptionally good. The food here is always very clean tasting which is fantastic. service here is top-notch with excellent recommendations as well when it comes to the food. This is pretty important considering that one of the first times I've ever eaten Thai food was at this particular restaurant. Most of the menu is a little confusing unless you've done a little research ahead of time or had previous experience with Thai food so their assistance with selection is wonderful. I particularly recommend the Thai tea as it is exceptionally delicious and worth every penny. The Thai coffee is also extremely good but it is exceptionally strong and will keep you awake for a long time so just be aware when ordering this for dinner. The prices for what you are getting food wise are also very good and I feel there's a very decent balance when it comes to cost vs food quality and quantity. Highly recommend

Noticed the restaurant from the street and never would have guessed they've only been open for 6-7 days. They had a breakfast and lunch menu, but no official dinner menu yet during their soft opening. The lunch menu had a variety of options including some hearty dishes, so you won't be missing out eating here in the evenings, even now. I've had some pretty decent Caribbean food over the years, and this place is pretty solid. I'd be willing to bet that they're even better in a couple months. We had the curry goat stew, slow cooked pork, duck prosciutto arugula salad, and the fried okra, and would order them all again. 

Also, the design and buildout are great, and there's a good sized patio.
the chicken francese is amazing!! you get a salad and bread with every meal, it is very reasonable. there balsamic is so good too. but the sauce on the chicken francese is remarkable, so flavorful

We visit this restaurant today on our beach day. We had a few drinks and had the amazing clam chowder. Also, we tried the Chicago oysters and they were amazing as well. The staff is super friendly and the service was outstanding. We as locals to the area will be back.

Food was ok, but fork was dirty for starters. Then my son found a hair in his food when he was almost done eating!  He told the waitress and all they gave us was a free coffee. Not only are we never going back to this location, the service was not the best, so we want to give you a heads up that this place is dirty! No tip for the waitress either. Horrible experience!

Same good food as always at just about any Cracker Barrel. Nothing stood out--good nor bad. Service was good and food was good. Gravy helping was a little skimpy with my Uncle Hershel's, but everything was good as usual.

This is a Puerto Rican restaurant that won't let you in the restaurant in a tank top. This isn't some restaurant in a high class area of town. It's on Armenia Ave in a Spanish Hub where the main patrons are Latin working men, and they won't let you in in a tank top. This restaurant and its owners has forgotten its island roots and are pandering towards high class clientele. I don't care how good the food is, I will not come to a restaurant that will deny a  hard working Puerto Rican man and his family from enjoying lunch indoors, while escaping the Florida heat because he is wearing a tank top. That is ridiculous, we live in Florida, and this restaurant is open during lunch. Charlie's steak house which is a world renowned restaurant isn't even that ignorant to the fact that we are Floridians.

Really enjoyed this place Tim, our server was great. Loved the green tea shot he recommended for desert! The watermelon punch bowl was delicious, and we had a bunch of appetizers for dinner. Would definitely come back and hope they open one in Cincinnati soon.

My favorite DTSP restaurant has a location across the bridge in Seminole Heights. My husband and I drove past Bodega while running errands, and I made him flip a U-turn so we could get some Latin food for lunch. The SH location of Bodega has it's own modestly-sized parking lot and lots of outdoor seating. They also have a fast-casual set-up here, just like their St. Pete location. When you're ready to order, go up to the cashier and a server will bring your food out to you when it's ready.

My husband and I ate at the restaurant, as the weather was quite nice. The dining area is all outdoors, with an umbrella covering each table. They have misting fans for when it's exceptionally hot outside.

I ordered a Lechon sandwich: lechon, grilled onions, mojo and cilantro on Cuban bread. I honestly love all of the different meats (and tempeh) in their entrees. The lechon is always full of flavor and never dry.  

Hubby ordered a Lechon plato which comes with rice, beans, onions and maduros. This is a full meal with sides. You get a lot of tasty foods, especially that serving of maduros. Bodega maduros are always ripe and sweet.

We ordered two guava and cheese pastelitos (because I refused to share one, they're THAT good)! We also got fresh pressed juices from the juice bar. I've had most of the things on their menu and enjoyed them all; the chicken is juicy and their tempeh offers a filling vegetarian substitute for those who don't eat meat.

I'm from south Florida, and I'll say that

I have been coming to Chase Grill for over 20 years. That said, I have so much sentiment attached to this place.
Chase is a hit or miss. I've had great service, poor service; amazing food and bad, that's just how it works. But when I want comfort food in Santa Barbara - I go to Chase.
Their weekly lunch specials are amazing! I highly recommend the salmon with the orange sauce and alfredo. Dinner tends to get busy so get there early. The cocktails depend on the time of day: in the afternoon they're normally made by the waitress/waiter which can be frustrating instead of a full-time bartender. Overall the food is always decent and there's always Frank Sinatra playing.
I know people can be thrown off by the decor, but it's just Chase. It's an icon for that reason. Sure they could use a few upgrades, but I keep coming back because I know what I'll get; a belly full of warm comfort food, some jazz in the background, and wonderful memories.

I loved everything about this place. From the beginning we were greeted by staff who asked us if we'd been there before. He explained the menu to us and we ordered. Judy is an amazing woman. She has a great personality and caring heart. I love that this business supports those with disabilities. The service provided to us was amazing. I wanted to show some love and support and buy one of their shirts. Okay now the food we got the garden salad with a raspberry vinaigrette- yuuuummmm! It was full of veggies and the dressing paired well with it. I always love a salad with pizza. Then we ordered the pepperoni Sicilian pizza with fresh basil. Delicious!!! Probably one of the best pizzas I've ever had. If you're looking for a delicious pizza place that wants your heart and owned by wonderful people go here. It's so worth it!!!

We were walking around looking for a bite to eat. Everywhere had an hour + wait except for this pub. It was a seat yourself (they have outdoor and indoor seating) we were immediately greeted by friendly servers. It seemed it be a team effort. Every employee was eager to help with questions and refills. They have fresh fish specials daily. My mom got the salad special which had fresh fruits including: blueberries, strawberries pears, and also had grilled chicken. I got the beer battered cod and fries. Everything came out so quickly and I think it was the best fried fish I've had in awhile. I would recommend everyone go there. It's a small place but it's cozy. Definitely check it out if you can. I will be going back while I'm here this week and every time I come back down to this part of Florida. (Edit I forgot to add on) Heather wasn't our server but she greeted us, got us drinks and explained all the sides and specials that are on a board across the room. Request her if you can - fantastic server!

I just found my new takeout Chinese spot!!! I ordered for the first time and not only was the experience safe (you wait outside ...contactless payment with a Bin for sanitized pens and one to place the used pens. Super clean. Friendly. And safe.)

Now to the best part. The food was amazing. This place for sure deserves your business if you have a hankering for Chinese. I got the pu pu platter with tempura fried chicken wings, egg rolls, ribs, shrimp, beef sticks (which these alone most restaurants mess up but not here. Best beef sticks ever)

Everything was packaged perfectly and tasted delicious! I can't wait to come back !!!!!!

Was really expecting a delicious meal from all the wonderful yelp reviews. But I was greatly disappointed. Maybe I can blame it on a rainy Monday night? I ordered the chicken Parmesan with marinara and asked for the pasta with vodka sauce separately. They made my chicken Parmesan with vodka sauce instead of marinara, which I told the waitress was okay and does not need to be remade (although was still charged $2 for vodka sauce even though my order was messed up- at least comp that). The sauce wasn't as flavorful as expected. There was plenty of it but it overwhelmed the chicken Parmesan. The pasta was also slightly overcooked.
Ordered the chocolate mousse for dessert hoping I could end the dinner on a great note. The description said chocolate mousse on chocolate cake topped with chocolate ganache. The chocolate cake had the thickness of what could be called a crust- it was probably a half inch thick. And there was NO ganache, only chocolate shavings on top. The mousse also had an overcooked cheesecake texture. 
Hopefully others have a better experience than I did.

I should take a star off for having a dumb name for this place. They should come up with an ethnic name for this place. It's also called TLK. 

It's typical good middle eastern food. Rice, lamb, falafel, chicken; all good, maybe a little bland for at least me.  Very reasonable prices. Limited menu. They have a couple of tables but it's mostly a take out joint.

I'm writing this review during the pandemic and I've taken it into consideration. We ordered three entrees to go tonight. They were all terrible. We've eaten these same entrees there many times and have always loved them. For $80 tonight it was so disappointing. Pasta was overcooked and a gelotinous mass, chicken overcooked and tough, sliders 1/2 meat to the ratio of the bun and they got the order wrong. Looked forward to this all week. So disappointing.

My birthday dinner at GW Fins was a pleasant one. They created a special menu that stated " Happy Birthday (my name)" with confetti on the table. The gesture was a sweet surprise. The food and service was outstanding. I highly recommend the scallop dish. The restaurant is near bourbon street so the outside smells the pee and throw up, but the inside is very nice.

If you're looking for an authentic cheesesteak this is the spot! I had the classic steak & cheese fully loaded. These dudes know what they're doing! If you're staying closer to downtown Philly it's definitely worth the drive out here. Forget all those tourist traps, come out here and get the real deal! Excellent service, the guys couldn't have been nicer. The whole place is super clean. This would be a great spot to catch a ball game, they've got great tv's and a big variety of chips and drinks. If I'm ever back in this area I'll be coming back!
Combo was loaded.  Wings were great.   Ordered for take out and it was ready on time.   We will try this place again.

First island themed poke place I've ever heard of. Makes me wanna put a grass skirt on and say ALOHA! I channeled my inner Samoan and decided to order. 

They have rare items such as octopus and spam. That's right. Spam out the can on a bowl. 

Let's start with the atmosphere. I walk in and thought I was in a Ron Jon surf spot. Surfboards on the wall and tiki paint. I think I'm in a LILO and Stitch movie. 

On to the food. Only poke place that defaults to 3 scoops of protein. It is $11 and for an extra $6 you get double protein. Then you can have unlimited toppings, mix ins, marinated, sauces, and crunchies. So you get your bang for your buck with you add it on. 

The staff is very helpful. One girl had one hand in a cast and still was dishing out bowls. 

Tables are box jump height. Plenty of room to do 14 lunges. About 2.65 seconds from the front door to the back on full sprint.  Easy to do dips on the bench seating. 


My only criticism is it took too long to get our food. When we walked in, there was 1 person already half way done with their food. It took nearly 15 minutes for me to get my food made. I did come in with a group of 4 tho. 

The food was a little on the spicy side. The water is decent. And they offered us free dole whip samples. But I'm keto so I could not indulge. Temptation is a sin. 

Overall, a pleasant experience. I'm still hungry tho. 

4 out of 5. 8 out of 10. 88 out of 100. 

Aloha!

Nice neighborhood eatery. I had the blackened fish, it was delish! My daughter had the grilled shrimp appetizer as an entree as it cam with 20 shrimps! Great prices. Outside seating available. I rarely get to the Westbank when I visit New Orleans from Chicago, but Westbank Grill is a reason to cross the bridge.

Nice little find!  Fried chicken was juicy and crispy, the waffle fluffy.  The cream chipped beef was house-made and the home fries delicious we will
Be back!

We hosted a rehearsal dinner at Caleb's in October and they did a great job for us. We stayed covid-safe in their tent outside, food was delicious and service was friendly and efficient. BYOB was a great bonus!

Worst zaxbys location I've ever visited. I've given them 2 chances and every time something is screwed up. First time we ordered wings and they were cold and gross. Today I visited and ordered 2 Caribbean jerk sandwich meals and when I arrived home neither sandwich had the Caribbean sauce. The manager apologized and said she was under staffed..... I fail to see how that is my problem.

Hatch & Coop was a great place to go for lunch during the workweek. You can order on a digital screen and my wait time was between 5-10 minutes.

I've been here for both egg and chicken sandwiches and would recommend both. The sandwiches have a lot of flavors and toppings. The chicken is delicious. I love their sides-the potato pancakes and fried pickles are delicious (and come with homemade sauces).

The pricepoint is very good for lunch too-around $10.
Pizza and salad were really good.  Everything was fresh and the service was good!  It is near Tulane campus so we walked there.  I would come back.
Ohyum!  Relaxing, real and reasonably priced.  I'll be back for sure!  Catfish crispy, fresh and hot. Potato salad perfectly seasoned.

I honestly found Einstein Bagels to be a mix of both good and not so good food. My friend brought me a apple cinnamon bagel thinking that I would like it because I enjoy apple pie so much. The bagel had far too much of their smear on it, something that was easily fixed by simply removing some. And I really liked to apple pie type filling on top. What I didn't like was the fact I could taste both garlic and onion in my bagel. I found pieces of onion from a everything bagel stuck to the bottom of my bagel. Whether that was because the bagel was next to that type of bagel in the case or because some stuck it in the same bag as my friends everything bagel I don't know. It made my bagel very unappetizing.

On the other hand, when my son ate his chocolate chip coffee cake two days later, it was still so incredible. If I do go back, the coffee cake would what I would get. But unless I am at that end of town, I doubt I will. It wasn't enjoyable enough for a special trip.

I have to say that we love the pasta night event that they have on Thursday evenings when there are not COVID restrictions. the pasta night food is excellent and a great bargain for the all you can eat buffet in the lovely exposed beam dining room upstairs.This is a very casual barn setting in the middle of nowhere with lovely rural scenery and plenty of outdoor dining options. They take precautions seriously and even have an out door hand washing sink.
The lunches I have had there are mediocre. 
I will return because its a perfect  spot for my friend and I to meet where we can eat outside and not too many other people around.

Well I don't if I agree with everyone else's reviews on here about this place.............
I COMPLETELY AGREE! The chips WERE fresh. The salsa WAS tasteful w/ the right amount of kick. Now let me interrupt myself and talk about the horchata...ugh the horchata! I mean not only was it good but for 3$ it comes in big fat n tall coke cup. #substantial. Now, before I was deliciously interupted... the main dish (Chile rojo... I think?) Pulled pork in mole sauce...was delightful. Again, having the right amount of kick. I think I will go with the flour tortillas next time though....as well as try a dessert. My only complaint...help a gringo out here..que es el metate en ingles porfavor?

Pretty good. Nice flavor profile on the plain cheese and pepperoni pizzas. Pepperoni was nice and crispy, the crust was perfectly thin, and the sauce was a good balance between savory and sweet. Overall thought the pizza, particularly the crust, was pretty dry, unfortunately. Customer service and turnaround time were great though, so I'll give it another go sometime.

I recently went here for a Mardi Gras brunch with a small group of friends.  We had a reservation and were immediately seated when we arrived.  The ambiance is very nice, glass windows in the front of the restaurant give a nice view of St. Charles Ave. They have a pretty nice menu and drink selection. Since it was Mardi Gras they added the traditional Mardi Gras meal, red beans and rice which I thought was neat.  I had the Sugarcane Pork Skewers (sugarcane skewers wrapped in pork sausage, grilled with spiced rum glaze on cabbage slaw)for an appetizer, and the Blackberry Glazed Ribs (blackberry ginger glaze, grilled sweet corn on the cob, creole slaw) for my entrée.  All of the food was tasty, no one at my table was disappointed.  The drinks were also good, I had a lemon drop and the pomegranate lemonade.

Our waiter was attentive and very knowledgeable of the menu.  The manager came by to check on us and compliment our Mardi Gras attire. Great location on St. Charles Ave with a parking lot located in the rear.

Flying out of town after a conference and wanted one last authentic N'awlins meal before heading to the airport. Settled on Serio's which was a few blocks from where I was staying. I saw so many things on the menu that I wanted to try. The owner was very accommodating and allowed me to patch together almost a sampler plate of a little bit of what I wanted instead of buying three or four full plates. What a nice gesture that he didn't have to do. Would recommend for both food and servi

Seafood Buffet was very good. Prime Rid was delicious and the crab legs were prepared perfectly. Had the bread pudding fir dessert, and it was very good as well. The service provided by Walter was impeccable.

On the chain scale, Raising Cane's gets a solid 4. It's definitely not a diet-friendly place to eat, with options pretty much limited to breaded chicken fingers, fries, coleslaw, Texas toast, and Cane's sauce. But it's tasty. And super fast. And they're not trying to be something they're not. It's a chicken place. Period. 

This location has a strange drive-thru. It's in the middle of a shared parking lot, so you have to drive on the wrong side of the road in the drive-thru. They need a more clearly defined drive-thru area, since it can be kind of confusing, especially for people who aren't in the drive-thru lane. Right off Nicholasville Road, though, so the location is convenient.

Terrible Customer Service from the guy at the front counter. This was my first time visiting so my expectations were a little high due to being recommended. He acted like he didn't want to do his job. This is not a good look for first time visitors! The pizza was also not fresh. He declined my offer to make a fresh slice and proceeding to say if I wanted extra toppings he would reheat it. After it was done reheating he just put cheese on top of it.  Ridiculous. I don't plan on returning.

Are you looking for the most amazing soft pretzels in town? Is your garden gnome collection needing a new addition? How about some delicious German treats?  Located in Pendelton Pike, this German bakery brings something unique to the East side.

Parking on the weekends can be difficult, but that's a sign of just how popular this place is.  A full menu with some amazing food.  The bratwursts are unbelievably good, but the rye bread is the other real star!  Fresh baked and sold in full loafs to take home.  The price of the loafs being fresh baked is also an absolute steal.

There is so much to explore in this store, a corner full of German groceries, rows of fun trinkets, anything from hats to statues can be found here.  

The cases full of German pastries and cakes and so tempting that it's hard to pick what treat to pick up.  On my last trip I got a pretzel, 2 types of cookies, and a small slice of cake (I wish I could remember the name of).  My girlfriend and I loved all of them and definitely want to come back to try even more.

The new shop is beautiful! If I go back-- it would be to the original location. The hostess was not friendly or even mildly nice. We were there at 11am on a Monday. There were tons of open tables, yet we had an hour and 1/2 wait time. We noticed every table was brought out bread, but ours. We asked for our soups to come out before our sandwiches & the server only brought them out together. We had waited an hour & half so we were really hungry. Our drinks were hardly refilled. The menu has expanded from the previous menu and offers much more variety. We came to the end of our meal & the server brought out the dessert menu. Sadly, there was only one type of cake to choose from. It was only 1 pm & we waited an hour and a half to eat at a place called "the cake bake shop". They are known for their cakes. The server barely apologized when we shared our disappointment & let us know that there are bakers baking 24 hours down stairs. I find that hard to believe. We have always had lovely experiences at the other location, but I will not be making another trip to the Carmel cake bake shop.

Review based on lunch 3/29/2019.  According to our friendly waitress, on this day the kitchen was breaking in new staff - and it showed.  Time between order - all from the specials menu - and food arrriving on table was about 40 minutes.  The catfish special was good but came without the side order of hushpuppies.  These came out about 8 minutes later.  The blacked tuna salad was ordered rare but delivered beyond well done - about the consistency and flavor of shoe leather.  The "greens" were primarily of white lettuce leaves with a very few carrot shreds and a past ripe tomato - inferior to the quality you get at Wendy's. This diasterous dish came out about five minutes after my dining partner's food arrived.   There was a large crowd waiting to be seated as we left so apparently the restaurant does much better on other days or with other orders.  For me, it was a major disappointment.

I've been here multiple times prior to now with family and I decided to take some friends here tonight and we've been waiting roughly an hour on a non busy night. In addition we've only ordered garlic knots and a pizza plus a few dr peppers to which they didn't have and we ended up getting Pepsi. I recommend the food from prior visits, however not warning us there will be an hour wait is absolutely unacceptable! I don't know if I will be returning after this experience. In addition, garlic knots didn't taste like garlic. Pizza was good, however not worth the wait.
We came here for dinner.the atmosphere was nice and the food was pretty good, however my grouper was dry. We would come back here, thanks for dinner!
Love this place I die for their million dollar bacon. Service is always great and they listen well to the customers. It also feels very homey.

We went there for Thanksgiving the food tasted like they just took it out of a can no taste. Definitely would not recommend and sure I'm not ever going back! Don't waste your money!! I have had better TV dinners! Way over priced!!
Rice was mushy and not much flavor . Beans were not good as well. Tacos were decent but not what I expected.
Sushi was okay. Had a to go order and they literally only gave my one piece of ginger for my sushi???

Back in February and before quarantine days, I was able to visit Annata for the first time. It was a Friday night when I sat by the bar and was immediately greeted by the bartender. He happily gave me an intro on their wines and menu. I was happy to see that they have an extensive selection on wine. I was able to purchase different wines from different regions by the glass, which made it more fun for me. 

I enjoyed a nice Bordeaux from France, a beautiful blend from Sonoma Valley and a deep Cabernet Sauvignon from Napa Valley and a excellent Bordeaux blend from the beautiful Alexander Valley. Cheers! It was so much fun to enjoy all the beautiful different wines. 

I paired some on my wines with different small plates, such as small charcuterie with cured meats and cheeses (pick 3 for $14) and oxtail tortellini ($18). The ricotta and oxtail stuffed pasta in bone marrow broth  was just divine. Everything was beautifully presented and delicious. The staff by the bar, a funny young male and a beautiful lady, were very friendly and helpful. They were both very attentive and always paid attention to details. Even the manager came by to greet the customers. Excellent customer service! 

It was a great wine night with delicious bites. I will definitely come back to visit.

First time, I ordered Szechuan chicken and it tasted as it is supposed to taste, spicy hot but not TOO hot. I've also had the Crazy Spicy Chicken and it was great -- confession, I removed all the chili peppers and it was perfect to my taste, but if you like hot, just leave all the peppers in. This place comes in second place to Lucky Bamboo, which is on Charlotte Pike west of White Bridge Pike.

We went in on Sunday evening  around five.  No one came to check on us at least 15 or 20 min.  Finally, a waitress came to take our order.  The wait for the food was over 30 min.  No one checked on us during that time.  Food finally came.  The food was good.  We wanted to tell the manager about the service.  Even before we could explain what went wrong, he said, "I know, I know."  His attitude was totally not acceptable as a manager....no wonder.....

My most recent visit to this Cracker Barrel was not great. I visited this location for breakfast/brunch on Memorial Day, so I expected it to be a little crowded. My friend made a reservation online for 6 people and was told that it would take 35 minutes. I decided to go there after 15-20 minutes to get ahead of parking and to account for any possibility that we would be able to get in earlier. They have a decent-sized parking lot, but the last time I came to this location I had to wait for a spot. I checked in with the host in the front and he recorded that we arrived on his tablet. We didn't get seated until 70 minutes from the time we made our reservation... that's twice as long as we were told!

When we were finally seated, the hostess asked another worker to give us three breakfast menus and three lunch/dinner menus. When we sat down we noticed that we only received six lunch/dinner menus. There was no waiter in sight for the next 5-10 minutes, so I went to get them myself. You can eat from any menu at Cracker Barrel, which is great... it was pretty much lunch time by the time they seated us. We ordered our food and our waiter told us that they were a little backed up...  we patiently waited another half an hour to get our food. 

I got the country fried steak with the hash brown casserole and sunny side eggs. The country fried steak was very thin and it was dry. If I didn't know better, I wouldn't even have thought there was any type of meat in it. It tasted like a very

I stopped by the Lolita patio for a friend's birthday and it was an absolute hit! Our table wasn't ready on time so they extended happy hour for us to get discounted margaritas! We did restaurant week, and it was super great, the food was delicious and the portions were huge! A little breakdown:
mushroom empanadas: 5/5
fish tacos: 5/5
smoked salmon tostadas: 5/5
vegetarian enchiladas: 5/5
branzino: 5/5
carne asada: 5/5
classic margarita: 5/5

This is one of 4 locations in town. If you like fresh fish this is a great sushi alternative. Unlike traditional poke this is a little more like deconstructed sushi in a bowl. 
The staff are very friendly they greet you as you enter they ask if you have ever been to poke king before and will gladly help if you are trying for the first time.
I ordered a regular bowl with white rice, green onion, shrimp and salmon as my protein. I had unagi sauce, seaweed salad, edamame, cucumber, fried shallots and furake on top. 
Everything was very tasty and well balanced. 
Don't let the construction on Virginia st deter you from stopping by you wont be disappointed. 
Fresh ingredients and friendly staff will make it all worth your while!!
Waited for 45 minutes for salty steak tacos and burned asado tacos. Not worth the wait.
One of the best Asian food options in Wilmington.  I've tried others and keep coming back.
This is exactly what Wyndmoor needed!  A spot for great coffee and sandwiches, yes...but also a place to hang out and connect with neighbors.  Bravo!!

We ordered through Uber eats for takeout. The packaging was very well done. The broth is amazing, very flavorful and the portion sizes are large. I'm not giving it 5 stars however because the description was misleading. We ordered the special pho with steak, beef balls, and tendons but the meal only had a couple pieces of steak. Besides that, it was really good.

If I could give this a negative rating, I would. This place is "TRIFFLIN". Not a SINGLE employee here has ANY sense of professionalism and I would not trust any one there to make my food. Not only did I find "hair" (cosmetologist background here, it was weave), but upon entering, an employee was screaming at another employee in the back... we get our food, no one says a word to us, apologized, said have a good day, anything. Not a big deal, but not apologizing for an EMPLOYEE screaming around customers... kind of an issue. Anyway, we walk out, get in the car... drive around to leave, and she's screaming at another woman before starting a fight and throwing multiple punches. Inside was disgusting, employees were "trifflin." I LOVE Wendy's, but I wouldn't go back here if my life depended on it.

NO MILITARY DISCOUNT.  The food, we'll it's Wendy's ,so it was as expected. My major complaint if they don't offer a military discount. A military discount is no different then any discount that they would ordinarily give a coupon holder. The main exception is ease soldiers his military members fight to defend corporations right to own a private business. I do not like doing business with anybody that does not offer a military discount.
Food was great and service was good, food came quickly will definetly go back next time in Reno!

I visited M.L Rose a few months back. I'm from Chicago and was spending a long weekend down there visiting my kid. I absolutely loved this place. Relaxed vibe, unbelievably friendly staff. The manager even spent time talking to me and my son acknowledging that she saw us here the other day. Yes, I liked it so much we went back. Burgers were great, bloody's and brew were on point. Great pub food overall. Didn't experience anything negative and will be back!!!
I love that this restaurant has come to the area! Dinner was so good! Staff was friendly. Their brunch menu looks amazing & I can't wait to try it.

This seems more like a fast food Greek place. The pita was stale, gyro meat was mediocre, Greek fries was just plain fries with some feta sprinkled on it. The Greek salad had Italian dressing and not a homemade Greek dressing like most Greek places. Also potato salad on the Greek salad???? That's weird...

First time in and the person who greeted me was friendly and helpful. Restroom was clean and tables were clean and neat. The hot and sour soup had a great flavor and texture. The Kung Pao Chicken was very good as well.  Going to try Cow Fun next time!
This place is the best! I would recommend it to all of my loved ones--it seriously makes my day. The customer service is amazing and the sushi is even better! Must try for everyone who loves sushi.

This past weekend my wife wanted a different dining experience and I remembered a restaurant that my son had mentioned about a week ago. Had never been to a Korean bbq before. This is my first Yelp review and I'm writing this because the experience was that compelling!!From the quality of the food, the abundance of food (for the price) and most importantly the service. Our hostess, Winly, was courteous, friendly and helpful. She guided my wife and I through ordering the food and cooking and by the end of dinner I felt like I had done this before! All said, it was a great dining experience and would recommend this to anyone who wants great food and service. Thanks Winly!

I'll keep this one short. Fantastic restaurant! Decent drink selection but the food, is just amazing. I can honestly say I don't think I've ever eaten fresher food in a restaurant. My steak was as good as any I've had in fancy steak houses! Everything is sourced locally and you can absolutely tell. Highly recommend this place to anyone.

My family and I had Sunday brunch. It was very busy but the waiting time was not bad, seems to turn quickly. The food was delicious! I had the pulled pork eggs Benedict , it was really good. We also ordered Cuban sandwich and the cinnamon pancakes. Everything was great. And the drinks are very creative ! The staff is very friendly and the service was fast and perfect!

Well I'd like to say the donut I had was very soft and a pleasant, sweet taste. I had the cannoli donut which would make you think of a Boston cream but it does still taste similar to the regular cannoli. Nice staff, greeted as I entered and I was waited on as I took a little time to make my decision on what I wanted. They have a good selection of assorted flavours and I think classic flavours start a little cheaper than filled flavours and specialties like the Apple Fritters which I have two.

  If your driving try to slow up if your near cause it's a little easy to miss if you don't pay attention cause it's kind of in the cut. They also serve beverages like I believe coffee to go with your sweet tooth.
Came here for their $2 taco deals tonight and we were not disappointed!! They were absolutely delicious & the service is great. We will be back for their Gyro's tomorrow!

Smiley Thai was recommended to me by so many people! We had it for the first time a week ago and had it again tonight! Their Pad Thai is amazing and the service is great. Definitely at the top of our list of local favorites!

Got the Fried Soft Shell Crab W/ Crayfish cream sauce.
It included Crab boiled mashed potatoes, grilled asparagus & garlic bread.

Conclusion ---the Bomb, can't go wrong on this selection. Highly recommended....
One of my favorite spots in The Village. Happy hour on the patio is my favorite. Wait staff are always awesome. Definitely a frequent flyer. Shamelessly.

We had lunch here today.

Pros:     Location and atmosphere is great.
Live music was excellent, but not so loud that you can't have a conversation.  Strawberry lemonade was the best I have ever had. Food was very good, but not excellent.
Cons:    The smell from cigarette smoke from other customers brings the place down a serious notch. My husband and I had two different salads that contained vinegarette dressing. We couldn't taste the dressing. After a very long wait we requested blue cheese on the side from the waitress. Both the salads went from one star to four star with dressing.
Overall, it was a nice lunch. We will try this place again, in hopes of not smelling cigerette smoke

Hobey's Steakhouse has delicious food and great prices. And excellent service Marco, Kevin and all the people who will be taking care of you are so Awesome. Sometimes we just decide at a moments notice to go eat there and they can usually fit us in. I love everything I have ever ate there. And it's a nice place for those special family get togethers

We've ordered here before and it's always been tasty, but I was always somewhat disappointed in the heat. However, my wife made a note to make it truly Thai hot.  They did not disappoint--it was truly Thai hot without being inedible. (For those wondering I had the basil leaves with chicken and shrimp.) The pot stickers and fried spring rolls were very solid, too. My wife always finds the red curry tasty,  but she gets it mild.

This place has the best breakfast you'll find in town. Very busy little spot but they'll get you in very quickly. Open only for breakfast and lunch and you'd be wishing you could come back for dinner! We felt right at home as if eating around the kitchen table. Their pancakes are amazing but their home potatoes are even better!
Hateful af every time I come here. Also super slow service. Then again what fast food place isn't anymore ‍

The burgers are delicious. And strange. And totally worth the trip. One of the best parts of fountain square. However, I'm torn about the atmosphere.
They're so delicious that they're always crowded. And the music is definitely a part of their metal/rock vibe, but it's loud. Like, really really loud. But it's metal, isn't it supposed to be? See? Torn. 
Either way, go there. Try a burger. I like the pantera. :-) my kid likes the slayer.
The food was really good & the prices for combination platters are very affordable & you get a lot of food for the price. I would recommend!

Ordered delivery from sweetgreen at this location twice this week. Both times the order was missing the requested utensils. Today my order was also missing the drink I had paid for. Calling didn't help because it's just a machine. So had to go out of my way to get my drink and utensils. So wasted money on the delivery and tip. Was also greeted with sass upon entering the store. Didn't know it was that difficult to read items off a list... won't be back
Great food!  The pizza crust is perfect and they use fresh toppings. The service is friendly.  Will recommend.

I really like this burger restaruant. The way they have you order is very unqiue and the line usually moves quickly. The burgers are usually high quality (sometimes they can be a bit sloppy, but they are easily fixed once they get to your table). It's also nice that they serve beer as well as spiked milkshakes! A great place on the Mesa! The efficiency of their delivery system is and has been incredible. We are a long time customers and this is our go-to, because it has great quality Chinese food and a quick delivery system.

Tonight we ordered the Imperial shrimp and it was creamy, garlicky and had plenty of shrimp and vegetables with it! We also ordered the pork fried rice which is always very good. My son ordered the sesame chicken, and he highly recommends it!
The freshness of the egg rolls and the wontons and appetizers in general are what brings this spot down one star.
A little more focus on the quality of the appetizers would make a huge difference on what we might order. Overall a good solid place for delivery.

Never been here before and my family wanted something different than fast food and Mexican. The restaurant is a little dark, adding to its character.  Loved the music! 50's and 60's. Tried to embarrass my 16 year old granddaughter. Didn't happen. She was enjoying the music too. Staff was friendly and fast. The menu options are vast. Theres a kids menu, which is great. Will we be back? Most likely.

Okay yes it is right off Bourbon Street. But wait, don't give up just yet. Tucked just off the main touristy drag is a true gem for absinthe aficionados, and for those that may be completely novices to the green fairy. La Belle Epoque literally translates to "the Beautiful Age" and pays homage to the period around the twilight of the 19th century. Meanwhile the Belle Epoque in New Orleans revives the glamour and decadence of the era.

Whether craving a libation, or looking to dine in Belle Epoque is prepared. The drink menu offers quite a few cocktails, single pours of absinthe, as well as tasting options for those looking to sample a mix of varieties. The staff are quite knowledgeable, and more than happy to make a suggestion for new comers. Among the many hedonistic edible offerings, the Parisian Gnocchi with lump crab, sweet potato, chilis and mead were truly one of the best plates I've had all year. I would have ordered multiple servings had they not sold out- be sure to get in your request as soon as you are seated. True to their name, the "ugly dumplings" may not be much to look at, but make up for their humble appearance with a generosity of umami flavors. They had quite a few other dishes, such as the sumptuous raclette cheese that was melted straight off the wheel, and a crispy duck breast glazed with spicy honey. Sadly we missed out on the chicken foie-lipop, but that just gives me all the more reason to return. They've also got a later happy hour for night owls loo
